meta.name: webapp-testing
meta.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.

copy.tagline: 用 Playwright 测试本地 Web 应用的前端功能与 UI 行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化测试本地 Web 应用的前端功能与界面
copy.tagline_en: Test local web apps with Playwright for frontend functionality and UI behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate testing of local web apps' frontend and UI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以编写并运行 Playwright 脚本，自动测试本地网页应用，包括验证功能、调试界面、截图和查看浏览器日志。
howto.when: 当用户需要测试本地运行的网页应用，或要求 Claude 检查网页元素、截图、获取浏览器日志时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试本地的 React 应用，截图首页。
say.note: Claude 会启动服务器，打开页面并截图。

say.text: 检查 localhost:5173 上所有按钮是否可点击。
say.note: Claude 会编写脚本遍历按钮并测试点击。

say.text: 捕获当前网页的控制台日志。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本获取日志并返回。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write and run Playwright scripts to interact with and test local web applications, including verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to test a local web application, or asks Claude to inspect page elements, take screenshots, or retrieve browser logs.

say_en.text: Test my local React app and screenshot the homepage.
say_en.note: Claude will start the server, open the page, and take a screenshot.

say_en.text: Check all buttons on localhost:5173 are clickable.
say_en.note: Claude will write a script to iterate over buttons and test clicks.

say_en.text: Capture the console logs of the current page.
say_en.note: Claude will run a script to retrieve logs and return them.
